canonical_statement: For probability measures on a nonempty Polish space satisfying the full large-deviation principle at positive speeds a_n tending to zero with a good rate function I, and every bounded continuous real F, a_n times the extended logarithm of the integral of exp(F/a_n) tends to sup_x (F(x)-I(x)).
domain_and_universes: universe u; X : Type u with PseudoMetricSpace, CompleteSpace, SecondCountableTopology, MeasurableSpace, BorelSpace, and Nonempty; mu : Nat -> Measure X; a : Nat -> Real; I : X -> ENNReal; F : X -> Real
ordered_binders: X and its Polish, measurable, Borel, and nonempty instances
hypotheses: every mu n is a probability measure
every a n is strictly positive and a tends to zero
the closed-set LDP upper bound and open-set LDP lower bound hold
I is lower semicontinuous with compact finite sublevel sets
F is continuous and bounded in absolute value
conclusion: Tendsto (a_n * ENNReal.log (lintegral exp(F/a_n) d mu_n)) atTop to nhds (iSup_x ((F x : EReal) - (I x : EReal))).

killed: changed arbitrary Polish domain to Real
moved the bound outside the F binder
allowed zero speeds and removed the LDP bounds

degenerate_cases: The root excludes an empty ambient space and zero or negative speeds. It uses EReal for the logarithmic value and variational supremum, so zero/infinite integrals and infinite rate values have explicit extended-real semantics.

alternate_encodings.inverse_speed: The beta -> infinity encoding remains uncredited; no checked reindexing witness is claimed by this statement node.
